title: Ghar lutaakar mai aayi hoon amma
body:
GHAR LUTA KAR MAIN AAYI HOON AMMA
KAHA ZAINAB NE QABR RE ZEHRA PAR, SUNLO RUDAAD ZAINAB-E-MUZTAR, SHHAM-O-KOOFA MEIN BE RIDA JAKAR, GHAR LUTA KAR MAIN AAYI HOON AMMA
JALGAYE KHAIME HOGAYE BE GHAR, SAR SE HUM SAB KE CHIN GAYI CHADAR, EK QAYAMAT GUZAR GAYI HUM PAR, GHAR LUTA KAR MAIN AAYI HOON AMMA
HUM PA HAR LAMHA EK MEHSHAR THA, NOU KE NAIZE PA BHAYI KA SAR THA, KYA BATAOU WO KAISA MANZAR THA, GHAR LUTA KAR MAIN AAYI HOON AMMA
<<DIVIDER>>
NEEL BAAZU PA HAI MERA DEKHO, KYA YE AJJRE RISAALAT HAI BOLO, APNI BETI SE KUCH TOH BAAT KARO, GHAR LUTA KAR MAIN AAYI HOON AMMA
WAADA BACCPAN KA MAIN NIBHAYI HOON, KHOON BHARA KURTA SAAT LAYEE HOON, PURSA BHAYI KA DENE AAYI HOON, GHAR LUTA KAR MAIN AAYI HOON AMMA
TUKDE TUKDE HAI SAB JIGAR MERA, GHAM SE AB HAAL HAI DEEGAR MERA, HOGAYA HAI SAFAID SAR MERA, GHAR LUTA KAR MAIN AAYI HOON AMMA
ROKE KEHTI THI YE HASAN DUKHYA, KARBALA MEIN UJAD GAYA KUNBA, ZULM KYA KYA HUE KAHOON MEIN KYA, GHAR LUTA KAR MAIN AAYI HOON AMMA..
